messages:
Ava (PM): Hey all — sharing the company-level OKR draft for the next quarter. Need alignment on scope and signoff by EOD Friday. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/okr-draft v1.3

Ava (PM): Quick summary:
- Objective A: Make inference predictable and economical for scale customers.
  - KR1: 20% reduction in avg token cost across top 5 workloads
  - KR2: 99.9% P95 latency for hosted endpoints under baseline load
- Objective B: Enterprise readiness and Private rollout
  - KR1: 3 pilot customers onboarded to Private (VPC/on-prem) with audit logs
  - KR2: KMS/HSM integration + SOC process audit prep
- Objective C: Developer velocity and adoption
  - KR1: Improve onboarding time to first successful API call from 10m -> 3m

Rohan (VP Product): +1 on structure. Two immediate asks: tighten KR wording for cost (measurement method) and explicit rollout criteria for Private pilots.

Ava (PM): Good call. Proposed measurement: token-cost is a per-customer weighted avg across sustained 24h windows — details in the doc. For Private pilots, see the "Launch Criteria" section (network configs, audit pass, model pinning).

Sam (CEO): Heads-up — if we commit 20% cost reduction we need concrete knobs (optimize + quant + routing). What's the failure mode if we miss it? Need contingency language.

Elena (Eng Lead): Implementation note: The 20% is doable if we ship KV caching + quant pipeline improvements early, but Dedicated capacity bookings and infra work are blockers. Suggest we add a mid-quarter rollback threshold and a canary plan.

Noah (Design): For onboarding time KR, can we add a user-test metric (time-to-first-successful-chat on sample app) so it's measurable?

Jon (Data): I can provide a baseline; current median time is ~9min across 120 trial accounts. Will add cohort split by platform.

Priya (People Ops): Small note — Q timing collides with hiring freeze window. If we ask for two SRE contractors for Dedicated burst, we should flag it to finance now.

Rohan (VP Product): Proposed edits:
- Reword cost KR to: "Reduce weighted per-customer token spend by 20% vs current baseline (measured over rolling 24h windows)"
- Add Launch Criteria checklist for Private pilot: "network config validated, audit log stream verified, baseline perf test >=95th percentile target, org admin onboarding complete"

Ava (PM): I'll update language and add contingency clause: "If by week 6 progress <40% toward KR, pause broad rollout and shift effort to technical debt backlog."

okrbot: Document updated by Ava (PM): https://docs.redwood.ai/okr-draft v1.4 (edited).

Sam (CEO): Fine, but add a short risks section listing customer impact and revenue sensitivity. Also call out cross-team dependency on Sales for pilot customers.

Elena (Eng Lead): Also call out capacity reservation windows for Dedicated — we should own the scheduling with Eng Infra.

Ava (PM): Will add both. One open question: do we want to mark Objective B (Private pilots) as "prioritized" or "conditional" based on security review? Thoughts?

Rohan (VP Product): Make it conditional. We can't consume gating review cycles for all pilots otherwise. Condition: "Gate opens after security review sign-off OR 2 customer commitments with exec sponsor."

Noah (Design): Quick UI ask — if Private is conditional, we should surface that in the customer-facing roadmap site to set expectations. I can draft language.

Jon (Data): For measurement, I'll push a small dashboard by tomorrow showing baseline and projection assuming KV cache + batching.

Priya (People Ops): I'll flag the hiring request and coordinate with Finance.

Ava (PM): Thanks. Action items: Rohan to approve wording for KRs (by Thu), Jon to supply baseline dashboard (by Thu), Elena to sketch canary plan (by Fri), Priya to confirm hiring path (by Fri). Signoff requested by EOD Fri from execs.

Sam (CEO): I'll review v1.4 tomorrow morning. If everyone hits action items, I'm comfortable signing off Friday. :thumbsup:

Rohan (VP Product): 👍

Elena (Eng Lead): 👍 will drop canary notes in the doc.

Ava (PM): Thanks team — will push v1.4 now and ping again when doc is updated.

okrbot: Reminder set for 2027-01-15 17:00 UTC for OKR signoff sync.
